transcript: Bhagavana Prabhati jag kocha gati Mahvari vinkar di ekonjante Bhanku pa saare aurib at liru Sintu risintu riyangan Mahvali, Mahmali, Brahmangangan Sauri alkastra mava saare amumat Injadra nao mein pui jagan Pai diri ratha maumat My little boy! ..and you are the one who loves you. ..I am the one that loves you.. ..and I love you. ..I love you.. ..and my love.. ..I loved you. पुप्राएप नाडपप है। 바르시아
